about: Data banks for bigger life chapters (companion/life/chapters.py): courses someone goes back to school for, and what they do with their days once retired, by era: modern (today and the future), jazz-age (the 1920s) and other (any older past, such as Victorian London, a medieval kingdom or a fairy-tale land). Picked by seed; never shown as a list.
